jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer / Process Engineer
jobs.desc:
Role Description
We are seeking technically minded and detail-oriented professionals for the positions of Manufacturing Engineer / Process Engineer. These roles focus on improving production systems, optimizing operational workflows, maintaining quality standards, and supporting efficient manufacturing operations. Successful candidates will contribute to process improvement initiatives, technical problem-solving, and the implementation of effective engineering solutions.
Manufacturing Engineers are responsible for developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing methods, production equipment, and assembly processes. Key duties include analyzing production performance, identifying operational inefficiencies, coordinating equipment installations, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring that manufacturing activities meet established quality and safety standards. They collaborate with production, quality, maintenance, and design teams to enhance productivity, reduce waste, and support the introduction of new products or technologies.
Process Engineers focus on analyzing, designing, and optimizing industrial processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and product quality. Responsibilities include reviewing process parameters, investigating production issues, identifying root causes, developing corrective actions, and implementing process control measures. They also support process validation, document technical procedures, monitor performance indicators, and recommend improvements that reduce operating costs and minimize material losses.
Both roles require strong analytical thinking, technical knowledge, and the ability to translate operational data into practical improvements. Professionals in these positions contribute to continuous improvement programs, equipment performance evaluations, production planning, and cross-functional projects while ensuring compliance with applicable technical specifications and operational standards.
Qualifications
Degree or diploma in Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Understanding of manufacturing systems, production workflows, process optimization, and quality control principles.
Ability to analyze technical data, identify inefficiencies, and develop practical engineering solutions.
Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies, such as Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or root cause analysis.
Knowledge of engineering drawings, technical specifications, process documentation, and standard operating procedures.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to work with production data, reports, and performance indicators.
Familiarity with CAD software, process simulation tools, statistical analysis software, or manufacturing systems is an advantage.
Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and teamwork skills.
Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple technical tasks effectively.
Commitment to quality, operational efficiency, workplace safety, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.desc:
Company Description
LUMI is a modern brasserie in the heart of Midleton, offering specialty coffee, creative brunch, seasonal dining, and a carefully curated wine selection. The team focuses on fresh, locally sourced ingredients and genuine hospitality, creating dishes that are both thoughtful and beautifully presented. Guests can enjoy breakfast, brunch, lunch, or evening meals in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere designed for connection and comfort. LUMI provides a vibrant, contemporary setting where great food and a warm guest experience are central to the restaurant’s identity.
Role Description
The Head Chef at LUMI Midleton leads the kitchen team and oversees all aspects of food preparation and service in a full-time, on-site role based in County Cork, Ireland. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing and updating menus that reflect seasonal ingredients, supervising food production, and ensuring consistent quality and presentation across all services, from breakfast and brunch to dinner. The Head Chef manages kitchen operations, including ordering and stock control, maintaining food safety and hygiene standards, and coordinating with front-of-house leadership to deliver a seamless guest experience. This role also involves training and mentoring kitchen staff, managing rotas, controlling food costs, and contributing to the ongoing development of LUMI’s culinary identity.
Qualifications
Strong culinary skills, including experience with modern brasserie-style cuisine, seasonal menus, and high-quality brunch and dinner service.
Demonstrated experience in leading and managing kitchen teams, including training, performance management, and rota planning.
Proficiency in kitchen operations such as inventory management, supplier coordination, cost control, and workflow optimization.
In-depth knowledge of food safety, HACCP, and hygiene regulations, with a track record of maintaining rigorous standards.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, balancing creativity with consistency and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working closely with front-of-house and management to enhance the guest experience.
Previous experience as a Head Chef or Senior Sous Chef in a quality-focused restaurant or similar setting.
Relevant culinary training or qualifications; professional certifications in food safety or kitchen management are an advantage.
Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

jobs.title: Kepak Supply Chain Graduate Programme 2027 - Ireland

The Supply Chain Graduate programme at Kepak offers an in-depth experience across the various facets of our supply chain and operations. Graduates will be immersed in the end-to-end process, from production to customer fulfilment, gaining a comprehensive understanding of how different teams and functions interact to maintain inventory, ensure product quality, and meet customer expectations. The role is designed to develop well-rounded professionals who can navigate the complexities of a fast-paced, data-driven environment, ultimately preparing them for leadership positions within the company.
Key Responsibilities
Inventory Management: Monitor and manage inventory levels across multiple production sites, ensuring a balance between stock availability and efficiency
Order Fulfilment: Collaborate with sales and planning teams to fulfil customer orders, ensuring that service levels are met or exceeded
Data Analysis: Utilise data to assess overall inventory positions, forecast demand, and identify trends or areas for improvement in the supply chain
Production Coordination: Engage with production teams to optimize processes, balance inventory targets, and ensure efficient use of resources across various factories
Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact between operations, sales, finance, and technical teams, explaining the logic behind decisions and ensuring alignment across functions
Problem Solving: Address and resolve issues that arise within the supply chain, adapting to variability in raw materials and changing customer demands
Quality Assurance: Ensure adherence to quality specifications, understanding that flexibility and adaptability are required due to the natural variability in livestock
Key Competencies
Numeracy and Data-Driven: Strong ability to work with numbers and data, using analytical skills to drive decision-making
Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to managing inventory, quality specifications, and operational processes
Communication: Ability to engage with a diverse range of personalities across multiple teams, maintaining clear and effective communication
Problem Solving: Agile in evaluating and resolving issues as they arise, often needing to find the balance between efficiency and quality
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift rapidly, requiring flexibility and quick thinking
Other Role Information
Location: This is a site based role, learning the end to end process. There will be opportunities to travel to other Kepak sites and external locations throughout the programme
Training: Initial period of hands-on training in production areas, followed by a transition to more desk-based roles focused on data analysis and inventory management
Progression: The role is designed to develop future leaders within the company, with opportunities for progression into more senior positions after successful completion of the scheme
Our Graduate programme allows dynamic, motivated, hardworking, and passionate Graduates an opportunity start their career with one of Ireland & UKs leading meat businesses. The programme lasts 2 years.

September 6th 2027

:
https://www.kepak.com/careers/graduates/

You must be mobile and willing to travel throughout the programme to undertake development activities at any of our sites in the UK and Ireland.
We will consider undergraduates from all disciplines and backgrounds.
Knowledge, Skills, And Experience
Educational Background: Open to all degree disciplines; however, a strong numeracy skill set is essential
Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools and familiarity with inventory management systems is advantageous
Industry Knowledge: A basic understanding of the meat processing industry and product specifications is beneficial
Experience: Previous experience in a similar fast-paced, data-driven environment is a plus, but not required
Personal Attributes
Resilience: Comfortable working in a challenging environment, including exposure to abattoirs and carcass locations
Team Player: Willingness to work collaboratively across different teams and functions, sharing the load and supporting colleagues
Versatility: Capable of stepping into various roles within the supply chain, rather than specializing too narrowly in one area
Precision and Focus: A driven individual who thrives in a repetitive, detail-oriented environment

We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). The Opportunity

We are looking for individuals with experience across offshore and onshore transmission systems, high-voltage substations, cable systems, marine infrastructure and associated grid connections. Working within multidisciplinary project teams, you will contribute to projects at every stage of the project lifecycle, from feasibility studies and concept design through to Front-End Engineering Design (FEED), detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover.
These opportunities offer the chance to work alongside experienced specialists, collaborate with clients and industry partners, and contribute to the delivery of complex energy infrastructure projects that support the transition to a low-carbon future.

Cables Package Technical Lead

Concept, FEED and detailed design across major offshore wind, interconnector or transmission projects.

jobs.desc:
Barden is delighted to be working with one of our global biopharmaceutical clients as they look to hire a Lab Services Technician. This is a hands-on role at the heart of a biologics laboratory, keeping day-to-day operations running so that study work is delivered on time and safely.

Confident using computer systems as the work requires.
Organised, safety-conscious, and comfortable working to daily and weekly routines.

jobs.title: Graduate Instrumentation and Control System Engineer (Dublin or Cork)
jobs.desc:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change.
What You’ll Get
Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions.
You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most.
The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges.

This graduate position involves working as part of a multi-discipline, highly interactive and coordinated team focused on projects including semiconductor manufacturing and other state of the art manufacturing facilities. Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Electrical & Control System or Instrument Engineering or Applied Physics and Instrumentation.

Permanent right to work in Ireland

Apply Online
Solo Video Assessment

jobs.desc:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Location: Limerick/Cork/Dublin, Ireland
Are you looking to work for a company that is Ahead of What’s Possible…. a company where you are empowered to Act with Courage, to Build great teams, to Create the future, and to Drive for Excellence? If so, then Analog Devices International (ADI) is the place for you.
Leading Edge Technology;
From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there. Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality. This helped prevent 33 million metric tonnes of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital xray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. ; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. Ahead of What’s Possible
.
Silicon Meets Software;
Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between. Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include; IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure. As ADI continues to grow its software capability we’re also focussed on building expertise in the area of Machine Learning and AI. We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.
One Company, Unlimited Opportunity;
The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program, to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success.

Electronics, Software, Computer Science, Physics, Maths Science, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Artificial Intelligence & Robotics and Chemical & Biochemical disciplines
. Our grad opportunities work in areas like IC Design, Product Applications, Design Verification, Design Evaluation, Layout, Embedded Software, Software Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Engineering, Failure Analysis, RF Design, Research Science, Technical Marketing, Test Development, Packaging, Quality, Reliability and Supply Chain.

Competitive Salary, Bonus Scheme, plus relocation assistance

Learning Opportunities/ Access to Cutting Edge Technology
Variety of Networks and Sports & Social Clubs

jobs.title: 2027 3-Year Graduate Engineer Program
jobs.desc:
BioMarin is the world leader in delivering therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with serious and life-threatening rare genetic diseases. We target diseases that lack effective therapies and affect relatively small numbers of patients, many of whom are children. These conditions are often inherited, difficult to diagnose, progressively debilitating and have few, if any, treatment options. BioMarin will continue to focus on advancing therapies that are the first or best of their kind.
BioMarin’s Technical Operations group is responsible for creating our drugs for use in clinical trials and for scaling production of those drugs for the commercial market. These engineers, technicians, scientists and support staff build and maintain BioMarin’s cutting-edge manufacturing processes and sites, provide quality assurance and quality control to ensure we meet regulatory standards, and procure the needed goods and services to support manufacturing and coordinating the worldwide movement of our drugs to patients. Come join our team and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.
BioMarin 2027 Graduate Programme - Engineering
Closing Date: 9th October 2026
Are you seeking a rewarding career in an end-to-end manufacturing facility in the biopharmaceutical industry? Make it happen at BioMarin in Cork
Our graduate programme is a three-year programme, designed to meet your development needs and career aspirations, incorporating your skills, interests and goals. BioMarin are looking to hire graduates to start employment with us in September 2027.
This programme is an opportunity to develop skills and gain experience across multiple departments, including:
Manufacturing
Engineering
Technical Development Sciences (TDS)
Quality
The BioMarin graduate programme provides a hands-on mentored learning environment to encourage development.
The 3 year scheme consists of 3 one year rotations across Manufacturing, Engineering and/or Technical Development Sciences and/or Quality.
Each placement will provide a variety of challenging, hands on, work experience. We are a high-performing, team-based organization, where colleagues are flexible, multi-skilled and empowered to make decisions. A high level of initiative, energy and motivation are key role requirements, as well as organizational skills. We are seeking self-driven, ambitious individuals eager to develop their careers in the Biopharmaceutical industry.
The Graduate programme will aim to
Provide graduates with an understanding of all aspects of an end-to-end biopharmaceutical manufacturing site
Develop the Graduates Engineering / Science knowledge
Provide the Graduate with the opportunities to apply that knowledge in the solution of a variety of problems
Develop technical and managerial Leadership skills,
Provide opportunities to develop Communication skills
Provide exposure to a regulated environment where high Quality and Patient focus along with Health and Safety are foremost.
Complete works that form part of their CPD programme to Chartered membership of IEI/IChemE as applicable.
Education And Experience
Currently undertaking a third level Degree / Masters in Engineering, graduating in 2026/2027.
Proficiency with standard office software applications, including MS Word, Adobe Acrobat, MS Access, MS Excel, MS Power Point expected.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and play a key role in our continued growth!

About the role
Contract: Temporary
Fancy a festive in-store role? We’ve got all kinds of shifts and roles available.
Across the country, customers are counting on us to make the magic happen – and that’s why we need your help. Working in store, you’ll tackle a range of tasks, from serving customers and stocking shelves, to picking orders for home delivery. You’ll feel your impact every day, as you send customers home with a smile. Experience isn’t essential – all you need is the right attitude.
Because here, it all comes down to helping people: customers, colleagues, communities. If you’re warm and welcoming, you’ll fit right in with our caring, friendly bunch.
It all adds up to a role where you can do good, and feel good, while enjoying great flexibility. Let’s make every day a little better. Especially at Christmas.
#tescoxmas
You will be responsible for
You’ll help deliver Christmas for households across the nation.
You’ll provide support in store during the busy festive period.
You could be stocking shelves and making sure products are where they need to be.
Or, you could be serving customers and putting together orders for our Click and Collect service.
Whatever the task, you’ll take pride in making sure that customers get a brilliant experience.
You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2
nd
Clubcard available.
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
Wellbeing Initiatives
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 170 stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated.   At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings.  We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

Please let us know you need additional support by emailing
tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Procurement - Purchasing Analyst
jobs.desc:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?
As a
Purchasing Analyst
at Cohesity, you will play a critical role in supporting our global manufacturing operations by ensuring material availability, supplier execution, and procurement excellence across a rapidly growing supply chain environment. You will work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional teams to maintain supply continuity, support cost competitiveness, and enable successful manufacturing and new product introduction activities.
This role is ideal for a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders to solve complex supply chain challenges. You will help drive procurement execution, monitor supplier performance, mitigate supply risks, and support the operational readiness required to meet customer and business commitments.
HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE :
Monitor demand & supplier commitments, delivery schedules, and order acknowledgments to production requirements
Create, manage, and track Factory and CM purchase orders ensuring timely material availability to manufacturing requirements
Coordinate with contract manufacturers and suppliers to resolve shortages, expedite material, and drive mitigation efforts for supply risks
Maintain procurement data, including quarterly pricing calendar, lead times, supplier information, and cost rollups
Support inventory management activities by monitoring supply-demand alignment and identifying potential gaps
Assist with new product introduction (NPI) activities, including procurement readiness, supplier onboarding, and material planning
Track and analyse supplier performance, delivery metrics, and service levels to drive accountability and continuous improvement
Support quarterly cost reduction initiatives through continued pricing analysis, supplier engagement, and procurement process improvements
Monitor supplier allocations, capacity constraints, tariff impacts, and other market conditions which may affect material availability
Partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and manufacturing partners to support execution of business priorities (NPI, RFP)
Generate reports and analysis on material availability, shortages, procurement performance, and supplier status
Escalate supply issues and coordinate cross-functional resolution plans to protect financial plan and customer commitments
Execute procurement request to purchase orders in Coupa
Ensure procurement transactions and supplier activities comply with company policies, procedures, and contractual requirements
Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at increasing partners efficiency, data accuracy, and operational effectiveness
WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING :
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
3 - 5 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, materials management, manufacturing operations, or related functions.
Strong understanding of supply chain processes, including procurement, inventory management, demand planning, and supplier management.
Experience working with contract manufacturers and global suppliers in a technology, electronics, or manufacturing environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed recommendations.
Proficiency with ERP systems and supply chain planning tools.
Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across global and cross-functional teams.
Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and a proactive approach to issue identification and resolution.
Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities is highly desirable.
Knowledge of supplier performance management, cost modelling, inventory optimisation, and procurement best practices is a plus.
Familiarity with global supply chain challenges, including allocation management, logistics constraints, and tariff considerations.

Privacy Policy
.

Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
Location:
Cork (hybrid)

€45,000 - €55,000, depending on experience
Type:
Full-time, permanent
About us
We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). From our Cork office, our team supports projects across Munster and the wider island, in one of Europe's most exciting renewable energy markets. We are looking for a graduate analyst to help power that growth.
What you will do
You will work at the analytical heart of the business, supporting decisions across development, finance and operations. Expect variety, real responsibility and plenty of learning. Your work will include:
Building and maintaining models for project economics, energy production and market analysis
Conducting research on markets, policy, technologies and competitors to support strategic decisions
Supporting due diligence on new projects and acquisitions, working with data from every corner of the business
Analysing performance data from our operating fleet and reporting on trends and improvements
Preparing clear reports, dashboards and presentations for project teams and senior leadership
Supporting the development team with data for grid applications, planning and site selection
Improving the spreadsheets, tools and datasets the whole company relies on
What we are looking for
A degree (2.1 or above) in finance, economics, engineering, environmental science, data analytics or a related field
A genuine interest in renewable energy and the clean energy transition
Strong analytical skills and real comfort in Excel; experience with Python, SQL or data visualisation tools is an advantage
Attention to detail and the discipline to get the numbers right
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn analysis into insight
Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly
The right to work in Ireland
Internship or project experience in energy, finance or data analysis is an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our people.
What we offer
€45,000 - €55,000 starting salary, depending on experience
Hybrid working from our Cork office
A structured development path with mentorship from experienced analysts and managers
Exposure to development, finance and operations across three technologies
Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support
Support for professional development and further study
The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets
How to apply
Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Hardware Electronics Engineer II
jobs.desc:
About Advanced Energy
Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. With engineering know-how and responsive service and support around the globe, the company builds collaborative partnerships to meet technology advances, propel growth for its customers and innovate the future of power. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
Our site in Little Island, Cork, Ireland is seeking a Hardware Design Engineer II to join our team!
Position Summary:
The Hardware Electronics Engineer II performs hands‑on engineering work across applied research, design, development, testing, manufacturing support, and documentation of electronic products and systems. This role contributes to the execution of defined programs and projects, working from established requirements while applying sound engineering judgment to solve moderately complex technical problems.
The engineer collaborates with customers and internal stakeholders to understand system and equipment requirements, applies analytical and experimental techniques to validate designs and concepts, and provides technical direction to engineers and technicians on program‑specific activities. The role requires regular interaction with internal teams and selected external technical contacts.
Essential Responsibilities:
Design, analyze, and support systems, products, and subsystems/circuits to meet defined performance, cost, schedule, and quality objectives.
Diagnose and resolve issues of moderate scope related to design performance, field reliability, manufacturability, and test yield; recommend and implement corrective actions.
Own and execute significant aspects of assigned programs or projects, including associated technical documentation and administrative deliverables.
Apply research and analysis techniques to validate design concepts, theories, and solutions.
Collaborate with customers and cross‑functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
Follow established engineering policies, procedures, and standards, including the Product Development Process and Engineering Change Order (ECO) procedures.
Work Environment:
Location: Cork (on‑site).
Standard office and laboratory environment.
Domestic and international travel up to approximately 10%.
Regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders across multiple functional areas.
Skills & Attributes:
Ability to exercise sound independent judgment within defined procedures, practices, and guidelines.
Demonstrated capability to adopt, follow, and consistently apply engineering processes and procedures.
Proficiency with professional engineering concepts and tools, including analytical methods, CAD and simulation tools, diagnostic instruments, laboratory test equipment, and component/material selection.
Proven ability to work effectively with general direction on routine tasks and detailed guidance on new or complex assignments.
Strong problem‑solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical issues with minimal assistance.
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Experience influencing technical outcomes and navigating challenging technical discussions
Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field is strongly preferred.
Minimum 3+ years of experience in electronic design and development roles, preferably within medical devices or other high‑reliability systems.
What AE Offers
Opportunity to contribute to the development of cutting‑edge technologies within the medical industry and beyond.
A highly collaborative, innovative, and inclusive engineering culture.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
Strong global and local career development opportunities.

jobs.desc:

We are Sweco.
We are Europe’s leading design, engineering, environment and regulatory consultancy.

We are #DifferenceMakers.
And we are now taking applications for the Autumn 2027 cohort of our Early Careers Graduate Scheme.
Now recruiting: Civil Engineer to join our Infrastructure & Environment Division.
Working with our colleagues across all sectors, in both Ireland, the UK and internationally, we deliver schemes through the project lifecycle – from early business case through to construction supervision.
Our teams plan and design Irish transport networks that support economic growth and connect people, goods and services. We are at the forefront of digital progression – using technology to enhance our delivery and the safety and sustainability of our services across urban and inter-urban transport networks, for both public and private clients.
What does the role involve?
As a Graduate Civil Engineer, you will work closely with experienced engineers and technicians to deliver projects by:
Undertaking elements of design from road geometry, drainage, and pavement to road restraint systems and traffic signs and road markings.
Producing design outputs such as drawings, specifications, schedules, reports and calculations etc, to achieve the optimum solution for the project.
Providing day to day technical input as part of a team of engineers and technicians.
Ensuring your design output is completed in accordance with the scope of works, timescales and budgets.
Working in close collaboration with colleagues from other disciplines as required to deliver project requirements and added value to the client.
Who are we looking for?
Our unique, personalised programme is designed for passionate, forward-thinking graduates who want to change the world around them, who will thrive in a dynamic team environment, and who are hungry to collaborate not only with fellow graduates, but also with mentors and leaders across the business.
What do you need to apply?
We want to hear from you if you…
Have a degree relevant to the role you’re applying for.
Have less than 12 months of relevant work experience (excluding placements).
Are confident using Microsoft Office and other relevant digital tools.
Are driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Can work in the UK without restrictions either now or in the future. This is a permanent role, and we’re looking for candidates who can grow their careers with Sweco without a time limit.
What’s in it for you?
Our Graduate Scheme offers a two-year blended learning experience, with a tailored programme delivered virtually and face-to-face. You’ll have the chance to network and grow with the 2027 cohort. Personal growth will be supported by our Early Careers team, mentors and subject matter experts from across the business.
Structured masterclasses focus on Internal Insight, Skills Development, and Subject Matter Expertise, helping fast-track your development as you pursue professional accreditation. The programme builds your confidence early in your career and gives you a platform for genuine impact within Sweco.
You’ll receive a permanent position with an industry-standard salary and benefits package, including 25 days holiday, a great pension and life assurance.
Read what our previous graduates have to say about their experience on the careers section of our website.
Please note, we will hold interviews for this position in January / February 2027.
All applicants will be contacted regardless of the outcome. We provide feedback to all attendees of interviews or assessment centres but are unable to offer personal feedback at the application stage.
Ready to make a difference with us? Apply now, and let's transform society together.

Flexible and hybrid working (Flexworks Policy)
Competitive pension contribution
Life Assurance
Allowance towards Permanent Health Insurance
Discretionary Annual Bonus Scheme
Payment of two relevant professional subscriptions
25 days holiday plus bank holidays (with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days per year)
Cycle2Work Scheme
Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, financial and work advice)
Employee discounts via Sweco Benefit Select (Faircare)

About Us
Transforming society together, we're planning and designing sustainable communities and cities of the future.
Solving the great societal challenges of our time is more relevant, demanding and inspiring than ever before. At Sweco, we bring together experts with different perspectives and skills to develop solutions that address the challenges of urbanisation, harness the positive power of digitalisation and make societies more sustainable.
We offer our clients a combination of global expertise and local presence, adapted to their business and reality. Our ambition is to be our clients’ most relevant partner, working together to help them solve their challenges, today and into the future.

It’s important to us that that all our colleagues thrive at work - we strive to have a friendly and inclusive culture which respects the contribution individuals can bring to Sweco. We aim to promote equality, inclusivity and diversity for everyone.
Here at Sweco we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity.

jobs.title: SAP O2C Functional Architect
jobs.desc:
Your career at Deutsche Börse Group
Your Area of Work:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Architect, with mandatory SAP SD certification and strong integration expertise across FI and Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), to join our Corporate IT team in Cork.
A key success factor for this role is strong end-to-end integration expertise, particularly with Salesforce (CRM) and Workday (Finance/HR platforms), ensuring seamless O2C processes across the enterprise landscape.
Corporate IT is the enterprise IT backbone of Deutsche Börse Group, supporting global business functions and delivering critical platforms including customer and vendor master data, financial systems, and data warehouses. This role sits at the intersection of business architecture, SAP S/4HANA transformation, and cloud integration, with a strong emphasis on billing, revenue recognition, and compliance-driven financial processes within Financial Services.
As a Functional Architect, you will lead the design and evolution of end-to-end O2C processes in S/4HANA, ensuring seamless integration across Sales & Distribution (SD), Finance (FI), Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), and external platforms such as Salesforce and Workday to support compliant and automated revenue recognition aligned with IFRS standards.
You will also support our hybrid cloud strategy using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), enabling modern integration and extensibility patterns.
Your Responsibilities:
Solution Architecture & Design
Own and lead the end-to-end SAP O2C architecture, covering SD, FI, and RAR integration within S/4HANA.
Define and govern integration architecture across SAP, Salesforce (Lead/Opportunity to Order), and Workday (financial processing and reporting).
Design scalable solutions for billing, invoicing, contract-based revenue, and event-based revenue recognition.
Define architectural patterns for integrating SD billing outputs into RAR, including performance obligations (POBs) and revenue allocation.
Ensure alignment with IFRS 15 / ASC 606 compliance requirements through robust RAR design.
Business Engagement & Process Design
Lead requirements gathering and design workshops with Finance, Billing, Customer Operations, and CRM stakeholders.
Drive end-to-end process design across: Lead → Opportunity (Salesforce) → Order (SAP SD) → Billing → Revenue Recognition → Financial Posting (FI / Workday)
Translate complex business requirements into standard SAP solutions leveraging SD, FI, and RAR capabilities, supported by robust cross-system integrations.
Identify opportunities for process harmonization and automation across the O2C lifecycle.
Implementation & Integration
Oversee and guide SAP SD configuration and billing processes, ensuring optimal integration into FI, RAR, and external platforms.
Design and implement:
SD → FI integration (account determination, AR posting, tax handling)
SD → RAR integration (revenue contracts, fulfillment events, contract modifications)
RAR → FI integration (revenue postings, deferred revenue, adjustments)
Salesforce → SAP integration (opportunity, contract, and order orchestration)
SAP → Workday integration (financial postings, reconciliation, reporting alignment)
Ensure scalable API-first and event-driven integration patterns leveraging SAP BTP Integration Suite.
Guide development teams on enhancements, APIs, middleware, and BTP-based integrations supporting O2C and RAR.
Agile Delivery & Innovation
Participate in and lead agile delivery teams, focusing on incremental value delivery in O2C and revenue processes.
Champion modern integration patterns (API-driven, event-based, cloud-native) across SAP, Salesforce, and Workday ecosystems.
Contribute to architecture standards, reusable templates, and design governance.
Operations & Collaboration
Collaborate across Cork, Frankfurt, and Luxembourg teams to deliver and support O2C and revenue solutions.
Work closely with Salesforce and Workday stakeholders to ensure data consistency and process alignment.
Provide expert-level support and troubleshooting for billing, integration, and revenue recognition issues.
Ensure data integrity, reconciliation, and audit readiness across SD, FI, RAR, and integrated systems.
Your Profile:
Core Requirements
SAP Certified in SD (mandatory).
Strong expertise in FI integration (SAP FI certification nice to have).
Proven hands-on experience or certification in SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).
Strong hands-on experience integrating SAP with Salesforce and Workday (mandatory).
8+ years of SAP experience, including significant exposure to O2C and revenue recognition processes.
Experience as a Functional Lead or Solution Architect in S/4HANA implementations or transformations.
Functional & Technical Expertise
Deep expertise in:
SAP SD (Order Management, Pricing, Billing)
FI integration (AR, GL, revenue postings, account determination)
RAR (Revenue Accounting and Reporting)
Strong understanding of integration flows across: Salesforce → SAP SD → RAR → FI / Workday
Proven experience with:
Salesforce integration (Sales Cloud, CPQ, opportunity lifecycle)
Workday integration (financials, accounting interfaces, reporting)
APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures
Experience with:
Contract-based and usage-based billing scenarios
Complex revenue scenarios in regulated or financial environments
Solid knowledge of:
Master Data (Business Partner, Customer, Material)
Cross-system integration and data synchronization
SAP BTP Integration Suite and extensibility frameworks
Working knowledge of ABAP and extensibility frameworks (BADIs, APIs).
Professional Skills
Strong architecture and solution design mindset, with focus on scalability, compliance, and performance.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across Finance, IT, and CRM domains.
Proven ability to bridge business and technical domains, especially across SAP, Salesforce, and Workday ecosystems.
Experience with agile (Scrum) and hybrid delivery models (JIRA, GitHub desirable).
High degree of analytical thinking, ownership, and ability to work independently.
Additional Assets
Experience in Financial Services or other regulated industries.
Exposure to IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition frameworks.
Experience with SAP BRIM, subscription or usage-based billing models.
SAP FI certification (nice to have).
German and/or French language skills are a plus.

jobs.desc:
Munters Corp Ireland designs and manufactures precision air-conditioning equipment for data centres, telecommunications, specialty storage and building-services markets. Our technology supports critical applications where quality, reliability and sustainable climate control are essential.
Role purpose
: To support the safe, accurate and efficient movement, storage, receipt, kitting and dispatch of materials across Stores, Warehousing and Production. The successful candidate will be flexible and may support different departments as operational needs require.
Key Responsibilities
Health, Safety and Housekeeping
Comply with company health and safety requirements and use material-handling equipment safely.
Complete required equipment checks and maintain the relevant logs.
Maintain clean, organised and hazard-free Stores, Warehousing and Production areas.
Report damaged materials, unsafe conditions or equipment issues promptly, and suggest practical improvements where appropriate.
Goods Receipt and Material Inspection
Receive, track, inspect and verify incoming materials and components against packing slips and purchase orders.
Ensure goods are received accurately and on time, with records complete and readily available for inspection.
Identify and report damaged, incorrect or non-conforming deliveries; isolate rejected materials and communicate with relevant departments.
Remove and segregate packaging materials such as plastic, wood, paper and cardboard in the designated areas.
Inventory Control and Storage
Organise and store purchased goods, semi-finished goods, parts and components in designated locations, following safety and labelling standards.
Apply FIFO principles and ensure all stock under Stores/Warehousing control is stored correctly.
Participate in cycle counts, investigate and reconcile discrepancies, and communicate corrective or process-improvement actions.
Monitor stock levels, replenish Kanban bins and notify the supervisor of shortages or replenishment needs.
Record all material movements, transactions and adjustments accurately in paper logs and inventory management systems.
Production Support and Kitting
Transport materials, parts and subassemblies to designated production drop zones and assembly stations using approved equipment.
Kit production orders accurately and in line with production requirements.
Ensure assembly teams have the materials, tools and equipment required to complete assigned work.
Identify shortages or shortfalls and communicate them promptly to Supply Chain, Production, Quality and other relevant teams.
Expedite urgent or late materials to Production and ensure all associated transactions are accurately recorded.
Remove excess materials, scrap, segregated waste and finished products from assembly areas to designated locations.
Shipping and Dispatch
Prepare outbound shipments and supporting information on time and in coordination with the Logistics team.
Load and secure shipments appropriately to minimise the risk of damage in transit.
Complete all shipping and dispatch paperwork accurately and promptly.
Communication and Continuous Improvement
Communicate clearly with supervisors, team members and other departments regarding material status, priorities and operational needs.
Support improvements in Stores, Warehousing, inventory accuracy, material flow and workplace safety.
Work flexibly across relevant departments when required to support business needs.
Candidate Profile
Experience And Knowledge
1-3 years of experience in material handling, warehouse/stores operations or manufacturing; mechanical or electrical assembly experience is an advantage.
Familiarity with mechanical and electrical components and basic assembly processes is desirable.
Basic computer skills and experience using ERP, MRP or other inventory-management systems.
Skills And Competencies
Ability to use forklifts, pallet trucks and other material-handling equipment safely; relevant certification is required where applicable.
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Flexible, reliable and willing to support different departments in response to operational requirements.
Physical Requirements
Ability to safely lift and carry materials in line with site procedures and manual-handling training.
Ability to undertake frequent standing, walking, bending and reaching.
Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment where noise and machinery are present.
Munters Corp Ireland is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher: Atomic Layer Processing
jobs.desc:
Post Doctoral Researcher: Atomic Layer Processing
Tyndall National Institute is Ireland’s largest Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) and a flagship Institute of University College Cork. Specialising in both electronics and photonics, Tyndall works with global industry and academia to transform research into products in its core market areas of electronics, communications, energy, health, agri-tech and the environment. With a network of over 200 industry partners and customers worldwide, Tyndall is focused on delivering human and economic impact from excellence in research. Tyndall is home to a research community of 650 people of over 50 nationalities.
Background to the Role
Within Tyndall’s Micro Nano Systems Centre, we have created a strategic research programme focusing on emerging materials devices and architectures for future information processing, interfacing with CMOS and beyond (“CMOS++ Materials & Devices”).
CMOS++ is involved in the Chips JU NanoIC pilot line co-funded by the European Commission and national agencies as part of the targeted initiatives of the EU Chips Act. The implementation of the Chips JU pilot lines is expected to bridge the gap from lab to fab and will be available to a wide range of users, including academia, industry and research institutions.
The NanoIC pilot line is the result of a remarkable European cross-border collaboration. Hosted by imec (Belgium), its partners include CEA-Leti (France), Fraunhofer (Germany), VTT (Finland), CSSNT (Romania) and Tyndall National Institute (Ireland).
NanoIC targets semiconductor technologies that will shape tomorrow’s high-tech solutions. One of the main goals is to develop the process steps and modules that enable these technologies. This will result in stable ‘platform’ baseline flows with a high technology readiness level (TRL 4-6).
These technologies are situated in three research pillars:
Advanced logic technologies
Advanced memory technologies
Advanced interconnect technologies
In NanoIC, Tyndall’s flexibility into materials integration will allow for rapid, short-cycle screening to reduce the cycle time in identifying and integrating highly performing materials to carry forward into IC development. Our role is to provide agile wafer scale nanofabrication and processing beyond silicon for the integration of selected new materials – Transition Metal Dichalcogenides (TMDs) and oxide semiconductor (OSC) – and FET device architectures. The goal is to develop a material platform for embedded DRAM and above IC functionality, thereby providing a key technology block to enable leading-edge ICs.
About the Role
The purpose of this role is the development of materials growth processes for oxide semiconductors and 2D materials, and their integration into device architectures for the NanoIC Pilot Line. More specifically this programme will explore materials to deliver high-performance FET channel materials (n-type and p-type) for integration at the BEOL of advanced CMOS technology nodes. The application of advanced material characterisation methods is also an essential part of the role. The successful candidate will join the Advanced Surfaces and Materials Group under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) assigned to this activity.  All work will be performed in accordance with the Institute’s research integrity and all other relevant policies.
Key Duties & Responsibilities
Collaborate with the Tyndall modelling and device fabrication groups and the wider technical team in NanoIC
Utilise an independent approach to carry the project work forward including to proactively identify opportunities for external funding sources, prepare grant proposals and the assessment of research findings for potential commercial exploitation in collaboration with the PI
Collaborate with project partners, internal and external researchers and carry out any administrative and management work associated with the NanoIC technical deliverables
Support access to Tyndall’s offer within NanoIC as required by the Pilot Line access model for external users
Engage in the dissemination of the results to the relevant research stakeholders in the appropriate form such as reports result to team leaders, partners, and funding agencies and publications in the top-tier journals and at leading conferences in the field
Contribute to knowledge sharing and provide technical assistance to students, interns and other team members where appropriate
Communicate the benefits of the research to wider society through active participation in several Education and Public Engagement activities, as required
Engage in appropriate training and development opportunities to develop own transferable skills, career and reputation
Ensure all activities are compliant with the Tyndall Quality Management system
Ensure all activities are compliant with the required Health and Safety standards
Carry out any additional duties as may reasonably be required within the general scope and level of the post
Essential Criteria
PhD in materials sciences, engineering, physics, chemistry or related discipline.
Hands on experience with either chemical vapour deposition or atomic layer deposition
Experience in material characterisation (for example: Raman spectroscopy, x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, x-ray diffraction, electron microscopy)
Capability of working independently and effectively within a team to achieve results
A demonstrated capability in idea generation and the delivery – both technically and operationally – of successful research projects
Desirable Criteria
A strong publication record in the field of materials growth by chemical vapour deposition or atomic layer deposition
Demonstrate an ability to manage self, time, resources and people to enable a high level of personal effectiveness
Evidence of multi-disciplinary collaboration with external academic or industrial partners
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
An ability to identify research challenges and opportunities within the semiconductor materials field
A thorough understanding of the research environment both nationally and internationally and the ability to contribute substantially to grant applications
Commitment to Open Science, e.g. open access publications, codes and/or research data
Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the policy, practices and procedures that are relevant to the role
Highly self-motivated, be able to demonstrate initiative and commitment to develop own transferable skills, profile and reputation to advance own career after the end of the contract period
What We Offer
Apart from offering a position in a very successful and positive research environment, with a collaborative ethos full of diverse competencies to boost your career, we offer the following:
Impactful Work: Opportunities to contribute to ground-breaking research and innovation that shape Ireland’s economy and the society at large

Core Values: A culture grounded in Ambition, Collaboration, Diversity, Excellence, and Integrity
Entrepreneurial Spirit: A proactive, innovation-driven environment that welcomes entrepreneurial and creative thinkers, including those with start-up experience
Supportive Onboarding: Structured induction and mentoring to help new hires integrate and thrive.

jobs.title: Financial Accountant
jobs.desc:
About the role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Financial Accountant will take ownership of the general ledger accounting and financial reporting for a number of operational wind farm entities. The role includes revenue accounting, balance sheet control, budgeting, management reporting, lender and covenant reporting, treasury oversight, statutory financial statements and audit management. This is an excellent opportunity for an ACA-qualified accountant to develop broad experience in a growing international renewables business.
You’ll play an important role in:
Taking ownership of general ledger accounting for operational wind farm entities, including journals, accruals, prepayments and month-end close activities.
Developing a detailed understanding of electricity market revenues and relevant government support schemes, and ensuring revenue is accurately recorded and reconciled.
Maintaining control of entity balance sheets, completing timely reconciliations and resolving reconciling items and accounting issues.
Leading the annual budget preparation process for assigned entities and supporting periodic forecasting and cash planning.
Preparing monthly management reporting, including actual-versus-budget analysis, performance commentary and clear explanations of key business drivers.
Preparing lender reporting, monitoring covenant compliance and coordinating facility repayment and debt service requirements.
Overseeing payment runs and ensuring appropriate review, approval and payment controls are maintained.
Preparing consolidated and entity statutory financial statements and managing the external audit process from interim planning through to completion and sign-off.
Building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including management, operations, commercial teams, lenders, auditors, tax advisers and other service providers.
To succeed in the role:
ACA-qualified accountant with strong technical accounting and financial reporting capability.
Experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, balance sheet control and account reconciliations.
Experience preparing management accounts, annual budgets and actual-versus-budget performance analysis.
The ability to understand complex revenue arrangements, interpret supporting data and communicate financial outcomes clearly.
Excellent attention to detail, a strong control mindset and the ability to manage competing priorities and reporting deadlines.
A proactive, collaborative and commercially minded approach, with strong internal and external stakeholder management skills.
Experience preparing statutory financial statements and managing or supporting the external audit process.
Experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, utilities, project finance, lender reporting or covenant compliance is advantageous.

jobs.title: Retail Artist

Retail Artist - Brown Thomas
Full Time - 30HR
Permanent Contract
About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty
Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury MBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy-to-use, easy-to-choose, easy-to-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.
Over the last 10 years, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has experienced exceptional growth and is one of the most talked about brands in the beauty industry and beyond. It has become a global sensation across 50 markets (and growing), with over 2,300 employees globally who are part of the Dream Team making the magic happen.
Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the bran­d is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.
About The Role
You can work at a fast pace to achieve and exceed KPI's. You feed on the buzz of achieving your goals and being the best, you can be. You do not want to meet expectation - you exceed it
"Team work makes the dream work" - is your working motto. You understand your impact and how vital your role is. You can adapt to change at the last minute and be a real support to your managers and colleagues alike
You champion the art of world-class artistry and an impeccable customer experience. You are a Charlotte Tilbury brand ambassador and want to pass on your knowledge to customer after customer. You live and breathe the Charlotte Tilbury makeup looks - and can recreate the magic of these on your customer, as well as offering advice and guidance. You pride yourself on knowing your customers are returning back to you
You follow the company grooming standards to a tee - you know what good looks like and are not afraid to display this
About You
You will ideally have had some experience as a Sales Advisor. Ideally this will be gained from a fast-paced environment such as beauty, retail or FMCG

Ideally you will have experience in applying makeup - and knowing how to adapt your style to different customers with different needs
You champion positivity - and can think in a limitless way that makes your energy shine

Dedicated Achievers.

As an R&D Co-Op Student, you will perform a wide variety of technical work in planning and design of medical devices for
Orthopedic Surgeons
to allow them to plan and perform their procedures. This role will support the
R&D New Product Development Teams
as they bring new medical devices products to market.
Technical Competencies:
Under supervision, you will assist in the following areas to support the design, development, and verification of electrical components for medical devices:
Schematic, Netlist, Layout Generation & Review: Assist in developing and reviewing electrical schematics, generating netlists, and performing layout reviews.
BOM Management: Support the generation, scrubbing, and review of Bills of Materials (BOM).
Prototype Design & Evaluation: Contribute to designing prototypes and evaluating their performance through systematic testing.
Bench Testing: Perform hands-on bench testing to verify electrical designs and assess device performance.
Electrical Stack-Ups: Participate in stack-up analysis, including:
Component de-rating analysis
Worst case/Monte Carlo analysis
LTspice simulations
Design for Excellence (DFX): Assist in Design for Manufacturing (DFMA), Design for Fabrication (DFF), and Design for Testability (DFT) reviews.
Additional Responsibilities
:
Support problem-solving and root cause analysis to identify and evaluate potential solutions against defined requirements.
Conduct research and studies to support innovative product design..
Business Responsibilities:
Understand the product’s intended use and clinical procedures.
Med Device Compliance:
Learn fundamental industry standards, design requirements and test strategies which align with regulatory requirements.
With supervision, create or refine engineering documentation, such as the Design History file per company design control procedures.
Learn R&D procedures like design controls and risk management, per the Quality Management System.
General Responsibilities:
With supervision, work with R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing and Project Management to ensure project success.
Learn procedures, policies, processes, systems, and technology required.
Work on problems in limited scope; purposefully learn while gaining experience.
Demonstrate ownership and integrity of work.
Build stable relationships.
Contribute to the project as a team member.
Educational Requirements
Studying / completed a Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Electrical, Electronic Engineering, or related discipline.
Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles, including circuit design and analysis.
Familiarity with electrical design tools and practices within a structured or regulated environment (e.g., team projects, internships, coursework).
Design Tools:
Exposure to eCAD tools for schematic capture and basic layout design (e.g., Altium Designer or similar tools).
Awareness of circuit simulation tools (e.g., LTspice, Multisim) through coursework or personal projects.
Analysis Skills:
Ability to perform basic analysis tasks, including:
Understanding of tolerances and their impact on design.
Simple statistical methods for data evaluation.
Manufacturing & Materials:
Introductory knowledge of PCB design and manufacturing processes (e.g., stack-ups, component selection).
Awareness of Design for Excellence (DFX) concepts (basic understanding is sufficient).
Documentation:
Ability to interpret basic electrical drawings and schematics.
Exposure to preparing or understanding engineering reports and documentation through class assignments or internships.
Preferred Skills / Engineering Tools:
Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for documentation and analysis.
Familiarity with eCAD tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or similar tools used in coursework).
Exposure to bench-testing equipment (e.g., multimeters, oscilloscopes) during labs or projects.
Willingness to learn PCB/PCBA print generation and review processes.
What we can offer:
Attractive salary & vacation entitlement
Experience our inclusive, people-first culture. You will be paired with mentors and have access to leaders who support your growth, give constructive feedback, and help build confidence.
Flexible working hours
Sports & Social clubs and DE&I Employee Resource Groups and the opportunity to connect with other co-ops
The opportunity to contribute to real-world projects that make a difference in improving healthcare and patients’ lives. In Stryker, you will be given responsibilities that truly matter.
Next steps:
Once you have applied to one of our co-op opportunities, our dedicated University Recruiting Business Partners will take some time to look through your application and ensure you meet the criteria in relation to the specific position.
Should all requirements be met, and you are happy to proceed, in September, successful candidates will be invited to a final round business interview with the hiring team.
If successful through the final round business interview, you will receive your offer shortly after
Please note, individual recruitment timelines may vary – please keep in contact with your University Recruiting Business Partner and your university placement coordinator for specific timelines and updates.

Ireland: €30,000 EUR Annual
